notes_for_editor: Thin record, and the story is shorter than the 120-word floor because no source supports more. Two searches and about seven page reads found nothing on this tower's construction, staffing, height, or fate. The firelookout.ca entry has only a name, a Blind River location, and coordinates; the type, height, year and elevation fields are N/A. Mapcarta (built from OpenStreetMap, GeoNames and Wikidata) describes the peak at 339 m, not the tower; the registry point (46.27021, -82.88837) is about 150 m from the peak point (46.27064, -82.89029). The GeoCities still-standing list (undated copy) has no Blind River or Fire Tower Mountain entry. That absence suggests the tower may be gone, but no source says so, so the story does not say it. Do not confuse with the Elliot Lake Fire Tower Lookout (a 1954 ranger tower on Fire Tower Rd, Elliot Lake, a separate site with its own page). The Ontario LIO fire-tower layer in data/raw has no feature near these coordinates. Status, access and visit remain unknown; no facts keys are supported. Brief record unchanged; no corrections proposed.
